_meta.source: Hand-structured from docs/13.5*.md Dominant cross-pillar trades (deterministic; not LLM-extracted)

tradeoffs.tension: Deeper retrieval and stronger models buy grounded accuracy; thin context and fast small models buy speed/cost but raise miss and hallucination risk.
tradeoffs.recommendation: Bias toward Accuracy/Reliability and provenance; bound Cost with just-in-time retrieval rather than context stuffing.

tradeoffs.tension: Provenance and refusal paths improve Definition of Done but add validators, retries, and sometimes human review.
tradeoffs.recommendation: Keep citation/refusal paths; treat missing evidence as refuse or escalate.

tradeoffs.tension: HITL or policy gates on refunds/writes buy Security and reduce Excessive Agency; they spend Autonomy and Speed.
tradeoffs.recommendation: Gate consequential writes; require identity before personalised tools.

tradeoffs.tension: Live API reads + policy RAG + validators buy accurate account outcomes; stuffed FAQ context is cheaper/faster and more often wrong or stale.
tradeoffs.recommendation: Prefer correct outcome / clean handoff over raw Speed; use turn/spend budgets.

tradeoffs.tension: Suggest-only or confirm-before-write buys Security; it spends Autonomy and perceived Speed.
tradeoffs.recommendation: Default assistive; treat prod config/IAM/data mutation as human-required unless ACC says otherwise.

tradeoffs.tension: Opaque durable memory can look efficient until drift, leaks, and rework dominate; whole-monorepo stuffing raises Cost and noise.
tradeoffs.recommendation: Session context + versioned knowledge; just-in-time slices; model routing.

tradeoffs.tension: Deterministic spine + stage gates + checkpoints buy resumability and correct end state; they add serial latency versus one unbounded loop.
tradeoffs.recommendation: Prefer Reliability and Ops (verifiable DoD, checkpoints) over Autonomy and raw Speed.

tradeoffs.tension: Tool Gateway + least privilege + optional HITL buy Security; they constrain Autonomy at write boundaries.
tradeoffs.recommendation: Keep gateway and budgets; never let the agent own the entire process without a deterministic spine.

tradeoffs.tension: Idempotent writes, compensation, and post-write verification reads cost extra; skipping them saves spend until duplicates and rework arrive.
tradeoffs.recommendation: Pay for idempotency and verification; enforce hard budgets on retries and evaluator loops.
